title: Cabana Blue | KEY.co
description_expanded: Cabana Blue offers a picture-perfect retreat in the charming Lakeside neighborhood of Blue Mountain Beach on 30A. This beautifully designed coastal home combines elegance with functionality, making it ideal for families and groups seeking a serene yet connected getaway. Accommodating up to ten guests, the home features a convenient main-floor bedroom for multi-generational families and an upstairs entertainment area that’s perfect for kids. The open-concept living, dining, and kitchen spaces are as inviting as they are practical, with a gourmet kitchen that boasts a six-burner gas stove, a beverage refrigerator, and a spacious island with seating for four. Step onto the large screened-in porch to sip morning coffee or unwind with an evening drink, all while soaking in the tranquil surroundings. Nestled within walking distance of shops, restaurants, beaches, and the community pool, Cabana Blue offers effortless access to everything that makes Blue Mountain Beach special. Guests can explore the area’s sugar-white sands, scenic biking trails, and local culinary gems like Blue Mabel Restaurant and Red Fish Taco. The nearby Blue Mountain Beach Creamery is a must-visit for a sweet treat after a day of sun and surf. Located on Florida’s famed Emerald Coast, 30A is renowned for its relaxed, family-friendly atmosphere, boutique shops, and unparalleled natural beauty. Whether you’re exploring the vibrant towns along this iconic stretch or enjoying the comforts of your coastal haven, Cabana Blue sets the stage for unforgettable memories.
